sportsFeeds.Notes: The Oaks lost their 3rd straight preseason game, albeit while AJ Dybantsa and Adash Stanley (PG) did not participate.  Coach Shepard shared that both sitting were percautionary measures at best. Stanley had left last game at half after jamming his non shooting wrist, while unclear on AJ but reports have been under the weather rather than injury. Whil AJ sat his fellow rookie recent drafties had the oppurtunity to get more touches. Coen Carr showed some touch draining 3 threes and scoring 14pts. Dame Sarr had a tougher time finding his way contributing 7pts but flashed on D with 3 steals.
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: The Oaks drop to 0-3 in preason while Stanley and Dybantsa sit for precautionary measures.

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Benji Dillon (SP), Vinnie Keane (2B), Mark Aitken (1B), Isley Kelley (SS)
sportsFeeds.Notes: The farewell season reaches its final regular season curtain call as the As play host to the NL's top team in the Rockies. As Vinnie Keane HOF career comes to its close a legacy that reshaped Oakland stands to honor it. Manager Deacon Seymour in his rookie campaign appeared to call all the right shots as the As rewrote the history books with the most single wins in a season finishing 127-35. Seymour had a few more flawless decisions ready for the final game. Benji Dillon would return to the starting rotation one last time as an A starter , Vinnie Keane would start at 2nd base in his final regular season game. What would unfold next could not have been imagined. Benji Dillon would give up 2 hits, strike out 8 in a W. Vinnie Keane would go 4-5 and in his very last at bat hit a towering 3 run home run into the left field bleachers. Fellow pillar Mark Aitken would hit 2 homeruns, while his FA is still inpending, Isley Kelley would fall short of hitting a homerun and ends the season sitting at 499 career homeruns, Darrin Davis after another injury shortened season follow up his previous season MVP campaign with a solid year, Danny Horn , Eric Taveras Ernesto Quintero all chipped in with a homerun of their own. For a sold out crowd that seem to be in a standing ovation more than a seated position, and chanting MVP  to most of the roster , they were repaid with the adoration with a 17-0 whopping of the Rockies

sportsFeeds.NamesUsed: Arturo Ramos (SP), Henry Rivas (SP), John Ellis (SP), Pablo Almanzar (SP), Carmen Mesa (SP)
sportsFeeds.Notes: The As just finished a historic season shattering single season win totals along the way. The A's pitching rotation was the main catalyst for this success and the rotation operated at most times like a stable of 5 Aces. Arturo Ramos who started the season as the #1 starter and A's ace never let that go as he finished 2nd in Cy Young voting behing teammate Travis Coles. Arturo Ramos now in his 3rd year started his carrer as rookie of the year and added his 3rd straight All-Star nod this year. Ramos carrer is off to a impressive start with a record of 59-15 and an era sitting at 2.79, Henry Rivas whos season had a brief stint on the DL still finished strong at 11-4, John Ellis who gets little attention for his mild mannered approach but going 20-3 this seaon after going 16-6 last season is low key ace material, and then you have the rookie calls up that both performed well, When Rivas went down Carmen Mesa stepped in and went a modest 5-3 over that span and showing great rotation potential, but in a late seasom move to give Benji Dillon rest from and prepare for a playoff run , step in Pablo Almanzar, who throws a no-hitter in his debut in NY and follows that up with a 2 hit shutout for the home crowd ending his last seasom spark 2-0 with 1.32 era. Question getting tougher now on whom makes the playoff rotation.
sportsFeeds.StoryAngle: As Pitching rotation is stellar all season

sportsFeeds.Notes: Vinnie Keane final regular seaon came to close and will forever being Oaklands. In a season full of success stories for the A's the constant amongst them all has been Vinnie. Undrafted to Undeniable is quite the arc for any athlete but to also become a leading force is the community and all the money an oppurtunity with his wife Amara may outshine his on the field contributions. Whether Vinnie remains with the A's or walks off to his Philantrophy he has earned either path and knowing Vinnie he may just take them both. Citizens now get to reflect on the favorite Vinnie moments. While Vinnie will suit up for one last playoff run and try to cap this perfect farewell season with the main prize,

Its unclear if Benji will decide to retire or look to pitch another season after this, but thing is for certain. Benji is a first ballot Hall of Famer. Benji has been the best left handed arm in the last decade or so and adds himself to one of the greatest pitchers of all time.
